title: [bug]在定时器中创建子程序会直接变成僵尸
author: fanybook
satisfaction_conditions: An alternative approach to process management that avoids zombie child processes
A solution that properly handles process lifecycle within the Swoole framework
A more appropriate way to execute external commands in Swoole

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

dockerfile:
FROM php:7.2-cli

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /usr/src/app

# Install dependencies for building Swoole
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    unzip \
    libssl-dev \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    libnghttp2-dev \
    make \
    autoconf \
    g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the repository at the specific commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/swoole/swoole-src.git . \
    && git checkout 3f9f5d04e8faa58e645b653487b1cf687a32f885

# Build and install Swoole
RUN phpize \
    && ./configure \
    && make -j$(nproc) \
    && make install

# Enable Swoole extension
RUN docker-php-ext-enable swoole

# Create a simple PHP test file to verify the issue
RUN echo '<?php\n\
$timer_id = swoole_timer_tick(1000, function() {\n\
    echo "Timer tick\\n";\n\
    $process = new Swoole\\Process(function($proc) {\n\
        echo "Child process started\\n";\n\
        sleep(1);\n\
        exit(0);\n\
    });\n\
    $pid = $process->start();\n\
    echo "Started child process with PID: $pid\\n";\n\
});\n\
\n\
echo "Timer started with ID: $timer_id\\n";\n\
sleep(10); // Keep the main process alive\n' > test_issue_2162.php

# Set the command to run when the container starts
CMD ["php", "-v"]
